title: worker.drained
description: Emitted when a worker transitions to draining / drained / stale. I17 enforcement.

status.description: New worker status. 'draining' = SIGTERM received; 'drained' = active attempts all terminal; 'stale' = reaped by reap_stale().

current_attempt_id.description: The worker's current attempt at the moment of transition. Null if idle.
